purpose: Maintain an explicit trace graph from every material citizen-facing answer component back to the evidence, property/date match, legal authority, procedure and verification event supporting it.
trace_rules: Every material factual statement must have at least one supporting evidence path.
Every material legal statement must have an authoritative legal-proposition path.
Every property-specific conclusion must have a verified property-match path.
Every historical conclusion must have a verified date-match path.
Every deadline statement must trace to the governing provision, trigger date and calculation result.
Every procedural instruction must trace to an official route or authoritative procedural source.
Limitations must remain visible when an upstream node is incomplete.
A source alone does not establish a conclusion; the graph must show the relevant extraction, match and legal reasoning path.
publication_gate: No VERIFIED_ANSWER may contain a material answer component whose required trace path is missing or broken.
revision_rule: When a supporting source, legal rule, property record or answer component changes, create a new trace/version while retaining the predecessor relationship.
